rejected.claim: Amazon S3 Vectors is now generally available in all commercial AWS Regions, offering native vector storage and similarity query support for AI workloads.
rejected.reason: AWS says S3 Vectors is in preview, not generally available, so please do not describe it as GA yet. AWS lists S3 Vectors as available in preview in only five Regions, not in all commercial AWS Regions. AWS describes S3 Vectors as supporting storing and querying vectors, but the page does not mention similarity query support.
